summary: Nissan Auto Leasing LLC II filed an 8-K regarding the creation of a new asset-backed securitization series, Nissan Auto Lease Trust 2026-B. The filing documents the establishment of the 2026-B Series, issuance and transfer of the Series Certificate from NILT LLC to NALL II and then to the trust, along with servicing agreements. This is a routine structured finance transaction involving auto lease receivables, not a special situation. The registrant is the depositor/transferor in a standard ABS issuance. No terms such as price per share or premium are applicable. What to watch: typical ABS performance and servicing metrics, with no special-situation implications.
